items.title: George "Jug" Jernberg Interview, 1963-08-23
items.q: Well, there were other good drummers. Herb Quigley, for instance.

ctx.x: You talked about Vic Burton as having supported the band. Oh, yeah. He's a great drummer. Do you remember anybody else impressed you that way in your experiences?
Well, there were other good drummers. Herb Quigley, for instance.
The preceding have been excerpts from an interview of George Jug Jernberg, a trumpet player around Chicago for the 20s and into the 30s. The interviewer was John Steiner.
